# mgcl_secret (Resource)

Manages a set of KVs in one mgcl Secret. It writes every key in `contents` in one atomic provider API request, creates the Secret (with its DEK) when it does not exist, and deletes only the keys it owns. It never deletes the Secret, its DEK or KVs that are not listed in `contents`. Values are always stored in plan and state; `Sensitive` only hides them from CLI output. The Secret name may contain `/`-separated segments; each `contents` key is one bare KV key without `/`. Each KV must be owned by only one resource or `mgcl_secret_kv`; different resources may manage disjoint keys of the same Secret, but overlapping ownership is unsupported. This resource cannot be imported.

> **Warning:** do not read the same KV through `provider::mgcl::secret_value` or the `mgcl_secret` ephemeral resource in the same OpenTofu project that manages it with the `mgcl_secret` managed resource. The mgcl provider does not promise idempotence or transaction ordering between resource writes and function or ephemeral reads; use a separate project for reads.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Values in mgcl_secret.contents are always persisted in plan and state.
# Sensitive only hides them from CLI output.
resource "mgcl_secret" "app_config" {
  name = "app-config"

  contents = {
    region = {
      value          = "us-east-1"
      ephemeral_mark = false
    }
    api_token = {
      value = "example-token"
    }
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `contents` (Attributes Map) KVs owned by this resource. The map key is the bare KV key. A bare KV key: non-empty, at most 64 bytes, and equal to its `url.PathEscape` form, so it cannot contain `/`. Uppercase letters, `.`, `..`, leading `-` or `_`, and other path-safe characters are allowed; characters that `url.PathEscape` encodes (for example spaces, `%`, `?`, `#`, and non-ASCII) are not. An empty map is allowed; `null` is not. Removing a key from the map deletes that KV but leaves the Secret in place. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--contents))
- `name` (String) Name of the Secret. One or more `/`-separated non-empty segments; each segment must equal its `url.PathEscape` form, and the whole name is at most 64 bytes including slashes. Uppercase letters, `.`, `..`, leading `-` or `_`, and other path-safe characters are allowed; characters that `url.PathEscape` encodes (for example spaces, `%`, `?`, `#`, and non-ASCII) are not. Changing this attribute replaces the resource.

<a id="nestedatt--contents"></a>
### Nested Schema for `contents`

Required:

- `value` (String, Sensitive) KV value. The value is always persisted in plan and state; `Sensitive` only hides it from CLI output. An empty string is allowed; `null` is not.

Optional:

- `ephemeral_mark` (Boolean) Whether this KV is marked ephemeral. Defaults to `true`. Ephemeral KVs cannot be read by `provider::mgcl::secret_value`; the `mgcl_secret` ephemeral resource returns them.
